segments.title: Reploid Robot Skin & AI Avatar News

segments.title: Science Desk: Living Skin, Deepfake Avatars, AI Ads
segments.notes: Chet commandeers the broadcast after the trigger word 'science'; Hype Train briefly possesses the desk; Chet wraps the robot skin study, Synthesia avatars, and the Toys R Us AI spot.

segments.title: Post-Science Banter & Jeffrey Setup
segments.notes: Case and Chet debrief; Case teases a Munch & Crum coat segment and queues the Jeffrey the Giraffe interview.

segments.title: Jeffrey the Giraffe Interview
segments.notes: Case interviews Jeffrey (real name Tom), the Toys R Us mascot, who reveals he invests in AI crypto, sold cigarettes in the 80s, got his neck sawed down after a sewer sex mishap, and admits to recent cocaine-infused banana dust use.

segments.title: Manchester Gang Leader Shot in Penis

segments.title: Sammy Seven Elbows Sings 'The Thing Song'
segments.notes: Flash-poll winner triggers a Cisco 'Thong Song' parody about Sammy's pickle-cart past and Italian swag; Kendelle wakes up and gets a feature credit.

segments.title: Viral Video Review with Rick & Gorilla
segments.notes: Rick hosts with a government-approved dinosaur/gorilla backdrop; videos include Spider-Man baking soda ketchup, drunk dog in sink, grandma tarot, foreskin pheromone guru, freedom water, Grimace lore, and a rejected UFC proposal in Russia.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Pepito, Dick Gibbon, Picasso, Elden Ring Fan, Rob Elvie, Chet Monk Alvin, Drunk Proctologist
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields opinions: Pepito humps everything; Dick Gibbon searches for brother Peter (sealed in studio walls); living Picasso drawing wants AI to replace creative jobs; Elden Ring grace dweller offers snuggle sandwich; Rob Elvie steals Trip's son's wedding invite and gets microphone-punched; Chet Monk Alvin fails a 2002 comedy set; Rob's proctologist cousin closes the segment.

segments.title: Facial Massage, Pimp Advice, Chapped Lips
segments.notes: Jeb and his board-trapped dad watch Expert Village facial massage, a 'tone bone 145' pimp tutorial (confidence, target 'hoes with active minds,' present as a package, wear imaginary $3k suits), and a lip-scrub demo with a toothbrush; Jeb practices on himself.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Cass
segments.notes: Case checks on sick Kendelle, announces Patreon at 6 PM, teases possible presidential debate watch-along tomorrow, raids Cass.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns for a second consecutive news night, handing the science desk to Chet for a deep dive on lab-grown robot skin, Synthesia full-body deepfake avatars, and the Toys R Us AI commercial. The broadcast then veers into a chaotic Jeffrey the Giraffe interview revealing the mascot's sewer-sex neck reduction and drug use, a Manchester gangster's machine-gun groin injury, and a flash-poll victory that forces Sammy Seven Elbows to perform an AI-generated Cisco parody. Rick hosts Amongst the Web with a government-approved gorilla, Trip Bradstein's park interviews expose Peter Gibbon's wall imprisonment and Trip's own stolen wedding invite, and Jeb Nogget closes the night with a facial massage, a pimp tutorial, and a lip-scrub demo alongside his board-trapped father.
